findings.summary: The scaffolded pr-ready job runs re-actors/alls-green with no allowed-skips, but verdict-check is skipped by design (merge_group, draft, docs-only, dependabot). alls-green treats a skipped job outside allowed-skips as a failure, so ai-sdlc/pr-ready goes red on those runs. This repository's gate lists verdict-check in allowed-skips. Fix: add allowed-skips: verdict-check to the alls-green step.
